# Alphaa

> Alphaa is an AI agent that gets businesses recommended by AI assistants — ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. It does the work an SEO agency would, for $99 a month: it reads your site the way AI does, fixes what AI can't find, writes what AI needs to quote, keeps your Google Business Profile active, and asks the AI assistants about you every week. You approve anything public with one tap.

## Key facts

- Price: from $99/month (Starter). Pro is $199/month, Full Service (a human does the setup and publishing) is $299/month.
- Month to month. No contract, no exit fees, cancel in two clicks. There is no free trial — the free check below is how you see what you'd get.
- No technical skills needed: the agent does the work, the owner approves.
- Built for local businesses (dentists, plumbers, restaurants, lawyers, clinics) and also works for online businesses.
- An SEO agency typically charges around $2,000/month and works on Google's ten blue links. Alphaa works on the single answer AI assistants give.

## Free check

- [See what AI says about you](https://alphaa.app/start): enter your website and, in about 60 seconds, the agent asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity a real customer question about your business, shows who they named instead, and runs 23 checks on what AI can read on your site — crawler access, structured facts, reviews, service pages, and more. No card needed.

## What the agent does

- Asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity the questions your customers ask, every week, and reports who got named — you or a competitor.
- Checks what AI can read on your site: crawler access, robots.txt, JavaScript-only pages, canonical tags, structured data (LocalBusiness schema), phone/address/hours, reviews, profile links, service pages, llms.txt.
- Writes and hosts the fixes: FAQ pages, structured data, llms.txt, fresh pages AI can quote.
- Keeps your Google Business Profile active with posts and review replies you approve.
- Sends one short plain-English note: what it did, what moved, what it needs a yes on.

## How it works

AI assistants answer from what they've indexed plus live web search. They favour businesses whose facts are clear, consistent and easy to cite across the web. Alphaa improves those public signals. It cannot edit an AI model directly, and it does not guarantee rankings or timelines.
